title: Embedded software is the biggest growth opportunity for open source
summary: When you link your bank account to Venmo, you're not using Venmo's technology, you're using Plaid. An Uber sends you a ride notification, that originates with Twilio. Maps in Strava, Doordash or Instacart? Powered by Mapbox. These are some of the most successful software companies ever built, and most of their end users have never heard of them.
